contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Whether you need support in software development or want to introduce AI into your company – we support you end to end: from data-protection-compliant use to efficient prompting that delivers precise results and responsible token consumption, optimising your cost-benefit ratio, all the way to a complete in-house analysis of your processes. Throughout, we keep compliance and data protection firmly in view – in line with the revised FADP (revDPA) in Switzerland and the GDPR in the EU. Get in touch with us.
